jem.smp.description.BOSS_RAID: Gather a party or enter solo, defeat the arena boss and earn personal victory rewards. Combat begins when the leader starts it.
jem.smp.description.BLOOD_MOON: Survive %s enemy waves solo or with a party. Contributing participants earn wave rewards and additional loot for completing all waves.
jem.smp.description.RESOURCE_RUSH: Gather natural resources in the marked area: eligible items and passive-animal drops are doubled. Player-placed blocks do not grant the bonus.
jem.smp.description.FISHING: Bring a reliable rod and quality bait. The Overworld offers the basic catch, the Nether has rarer finds, and the End holds the most valuable rewards.
jem.smp.description.COOKING_SHOW: Prepare %s dishes (%s types) from the list before the event ends. Cooking counts toward progress and you keep the dishes. Completing the list earns one reward.
jem.smp.description.BOSS: Gather a party or choose Solo. Prepare for the encounter and start when every participant is ready.
jem.smp.dissolve_confirm: Leaving as leader will dissolve this party. Continue?
jem.smp.description.COOKING_SHOW_planned: The dish list appears when the event begins. You have %s minutes to cook it. Completing the full list earns a reward.
jem.smp.description.EXPLORATION: Explore together: agree on a route and meeting point with the organizer.
jem.smp.description.BUILDING: Build together: discuss the plan and materials with the organizer.
jem.smp.description.TRADING: Meet to trade: agree on items and exchange terms with the participants.
jem.smp.description.CUSTOM: A player gathering arranged by the organizer.
jem.smp.rule.fishing_tier: World Tier does not change XP: tiers 1, 2 and above use the same ranges.
jem.smp.rule.fishing_factors: XP depends on fish rarity and behavior, rod quality, catch conditions and luck.
jem.smp.rule.fishing_void: Void fishing applies ×%s: Overworld %s, Nether %s, End %s XP.
jem.smp.rule.fishing_capped: The void bonus is capped at the normal XP maximum for the current dimension.
jem.smp.rule.fishing_uncapped: The void bonus can exceed the normal XP maximum for the dimension.
jem.smp.rule.fishing_access: The Nether, End and void require a compatible rod or hook; each fish keeps its native catch requirements.
jem.smp.rule.fishing_reward: Event XP is awarded immediately for fish; junk and treasure do not grant event XP.
jem.smp.rule.rush_natural: Each natural block position counts once; placed blocks are excluded.
jem.smp.rule.rush_silk_touch: Silk Touch ore drops and blocks with inventories do not receive the bonus.
jem.smp.rule.rush_animals: Cows, sheep, pigs, chickens, and other passive animals inside the zone drop twice as much loot.
jem.smp.rule.rush_animal_boundary: Passive animals cannot be moved into or out of the zone until the event ends.
jem.smp.rule.rush_tracking_full: The tracking limit was reached: the bonus for this event is paused.
